The '''Eucer sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] that was located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Planets in the sector included [[Darlon]] and [[Euceron]] itself.

==History==
Around [[24,000 BBY]], the Eucer sector worlds of [[Matabre]], [[Cortilium Major]], [[Uthtara]], [[Okator VIII]] and [[Ilamna]] were located in a stretch of space known as "[[the Divide]]," which separated the territories of the young [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]]. During the [[Tionese War]], the [[Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion|Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion]] attacked a number of worlds in the region, including Uthtara and Okator.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], the sector was represented by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Jonas Wallen]]. He was involved in a [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] scandal in which he was accused of betting on which [[Planet/Legends|planets]] would secede from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="HNN51" />
